stem: You meet with your team to determine the life cycle for your project. After analyzing the best way to define and manage requirements, develop deliverables, handle changes, control risk and cost, and engage key stakeholders, the decision is made to select a hybrid life cycle. With the project life cycle selected, how often will the key stakeholders be involved?
key: Regularly

stem: With a building construction project underway, the director of finance has retired from the performing organization and has now been replaced. The new director of finance has raised concerns about the validity of the project's business case. You have made an assessment of the new stakeholder's relative power, interest, and engagement level and updated the stakeholder register and the project management plan accordingly. What should you do next?
key: Submit a change request to update the stakeholder engagement plan

stem: At the end of an agile project chartering session, a stakeholder asks the project manager when will be the first opportunity to view the team's progress on the development of the new application. Which scrum event should the project manager suggest to the stakeholder to attend?
key: Daily scrum meeting

stem: A project team is comprised of former military and non-military team members. The team members without a military background view the former military team members as overly structured and rigid in their approach to the project. The former military members view the other team members' more casual approach as an indication that they are less committed to the project. What tool or technique will be the most useful for the project manager and the team members to communicate effectively?
key: Conflict management

stem: Several key stakeholders have been missing from iteration reviews. What is the best course of action for an agile practitioner?
key: Move the review meetings to a more convenient time for the stakeholders

stem: Your project is installing WiFi stations in rural areas. The response rate for the surveys sent out to residents in the affected areas has been extremely low. Expectations were to have a majority of them returned by this point in the project. What most likely is the reason for this issue?
key: There is a misunderstanding of the culture of the affected stakeholders.
